name: Get Vehicle Availability
description:
The Get Vehicle Availability API is used to request information regarding car rental location(s), available car types at the location(s), and the rates of those cars.
* A specific car supplier at a specific location
* One to all car suppliers that serve a specific airport
* One to all car suppliers around a specific point for a variable distance
Get Vehicle Availability responses include:vehicle rates, vehicle types, legal number of occupants, number of bags.
